matrix.purpose: EXPLORATORY evidence gathering only. Not a promotion holdout and not proof of anything; no correction is promoted from these games.
matrix.seedNote: 10 predetermined seeds never used by V1 (1000-1011, 5000-5011) or V2 (3000-3003, 3100-3115, 3200-3215, 7000-7015, 7100-7115). The same 10 seeds are used in every condition (paired exploratory comparison); every seed is played once with Human moving first and once with AI moving first. RNG divergence between configurations is recorded per game.
matrix.actionPolicy: UNCHANGED: actions per turn = own pieces still on the board + banked bonus. Piece count therefore also changes action capacity and the victory requirement (all own pieces across). This is a property of the condition, not an isolated strategic advantage.
matrix.outcomeRule: Completion: a side wins at once when all of its own pieces are across. Turn limit (60 turns, 30 each): higher fraction of own pieces across wins; then lower fraction of the total journey left (squares left / (own pieces x 6)); then a draw. Exact integer comparison. For equal counts this is identical to the production rule.
matrix.planner: Production planner (server/ai.ts planTurn) for BOTH sides with the production weights balance/balance.weights.json, no hooks, no rule variant.

externalCalls.note: Counted by the offline guard in the main thread and in every worker; every outbound channel is replaced by a counting stub that throws.

imports.note: network/child_process builtins may only be imported by offline.ts (which replaces them with blocking stubs)
